summary: Visual verification of the OTC Desk card arrows on /business page. The bug fix (replacing SVG <marker> arrowheads with explicit filled triangle <path> elements) is working correctly. Both arrows now display LARGE, clearly visible triangular arrowheads matching the reference marketing illustration. All regression checks pass on desktop (1440px) and mobile (375px).
critical_code_review_comments: Business.tsx is 445 lines - still manageable but approaching split threshold if more sections are added.

Newsletter modal popup auto-reopens on viewport resize/navigation and overlaps page content. Not part of this bug but worth noting - the popup covered the OTC card during first test pass and had to be removed via JS to screenshot.

SVG arrowhead triangles are drawn as independent filled paths with manual rotation transforms. This works but is brittle if the curve stroke width or endpoint changes - consider refactoring to use properly sized <marker> elements with markerUnits='userSpaceOnUse' and large (e.g., 20x20) markerWidth/Height if future changes are needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The OTC Desk arrow bug (/business page, .bz-card-blue) is FIXED. Both arrows display large, clearly visible triangular arrowheads (green down-left, blue up-right). Verified at desktop 1440px and mobile 375px. The 4 SVG paths are: 2 stroke curves (stroke-width=13) + 2 filled triangles (fill #22c55e and #2f9cf0). The .bz-page CSS has zoom:1.15 by design. Note: a newsletter popup modal auto-opens and may cover content during testing - inject localStorage keys or remove the modal via JS before screenshotting.
rca of the issue: Previous implementation used SVG <marker> elements for arrowheads which rendered too small (markers scale with stroke-width in orientation but their default size caps). Fixed by replacing markers with explicit filled triangle <path> elements (points 38,158 88,158 60,210 rotated -9deg for green; 322,76 372,76 350,22 rotated 9deg for blue), giving large, prominent arrowheads visible as bold marketing-style arrows.
